ITEM 1 | Rectangular/triangular piece of baked dish with a bright red-orange tomato sauce layer over pale cream-white melted topping, browned spots and golden edges, soft and moist, sitting at upper left of plate, about 8 x 6 cm footprint and 2.5 cm thick | 150
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown crust piece with a lighter, slightly crumbly interior and a bit of stringy cheese-like white topping, with red sauce flecks, at upper left beside the sauced piece, about 4 x 3 cm and 2 cm thick | 50
ITEM 3 | Large irregular piece of cooked item with golden-orange and cream coloring, wrinkled surface, soft and moist with a glossy sheen, partly browned at edges, at upper right of plate, about 7 x 6 cm footprint and 4 cm tall | 130
ITEM 4 | Sliced meat, three pieces, dark brown-grey outer crust with pinkish-red interior, moist and slightly glossy, fibrous grain visible, each slice about 5 x 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick, center-left of plate | 120
ITEM 5 | Whole and halved Brussels sprouts, bright to olive green with darker charred edges and a light sheen of oil, firm and holding shape, around 8 to 9 pieces clustered center and lower right, each about 2.5 cm across | 110
ITEM 6 | Cauliflower florets, pale cream-yellow with slight golden browning on tips, firm and dry-looking, clustered at lower left, florets about 2 to 3 cm across, several pieces | 120
ITEM 7 | Loose yellow-orange rice with separate grains, speckled with small red and green bits, dry and fluffy, spread over the right side of the plate in a mound about 10 x 7 cm and 1.5 cm tall | 150
ITEM 8 | Small scattered red pepper flakes and sauce specks on the plate surface, at left edge and near the rice, negligible amount | 2
